text:
Elena: Heads-up — staging linkcheck failed after the docs migration. Looks like a heading slug changed and one embedded diagram is 404.

DocsBot: Linkcheck failed for build #299 https://ci.redwood/299 :warning:

Elena: Error excerpt:
```
WARN Broken fragment: /guides/llm-serving.md#best-practices -> fragment not found
WARN Missing file: /assets/diagrams/serve-flow.png -> 404
```

Tom R.: I bet the MDX conversion changed the auto-slug. `Best practices` likely became `#best-practices-for-llm-serving`.

Yuki: Quick grep shows 2 references still pointing at `#best-practices`. Also the diagram got moved to `static/img/serve-flow.png` during the restructure but the doc still uses a relative path.

Elena: Proposed fixes: update the three refs to the new slug, change image paths to `/img/serve-flow.png`, and add an explicit short id on the target heading for backward compatibility: `### Best practices for LLM serving {#best-practices}`.

Tom R.: Updating refs + adding the short id sounds safe. If external blogs link to the old fragment, the explicit id will keep them working.

QA Bot: Suggested PR checklist:
- [ ] Update broken fragments to `#best-practices-for-llm-serving` or add explicit `{#best-practices}`
- [ ] Fix image paths to site-root `/img/serve-flow.png`
- [ ] Update SDK examples that link into the guide
- [ ] Run `pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:linkcheck` locally

Elena: Opening a tiny PR with the three link updates, the image path fix, and the heading id. Will also add a minimal unit test that checks head->fragment presence for changed files. PR coming up.

DocsBot: PR 856 opened by Elena: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/856 — includes link and image fixes, plus `tests/test_fragments.py`. CI queued.

QA Bot: Running linkcheck on the PR branch in CI.

DocsBot: CI for PR 856 — linkcheck step passed :white_check_mark:. Full build green.

Tom R.: Merged. Staging linkcheck now green. Thanks!

Yuki: Filing a follow-up to add a pre-commit script that runs a quick fragment validator on changed markdown files to catch these earlier.

Elena: Added a short note to the migration guide about MDX slug differences and when to add explicit heading ids. Closing thread. :tada:
